page: Google Cloud Platform a3-ultragpu-8g is an accelerator-optimized server designed for high-density compute workloads. It features 224 vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8581C processors with an x86_64 architecture, operating at 2.1 GHz across 112 physical cores. The system is equipped with 2952.0 GB of system memory, providing 13.18 GB per core. For acceleration, it integrates eight NVIDIA H200 Hopper GPUs with a combined VRAM capacity of 1123 GB. Local storage consists of a 12599 GB NVMe SSD array.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance in multi-core CPU execution and memory bandwidth. The server achieved a stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 180093.2 and a Passmark CPU score of 134560.46, both placing in the top 10% tier. Large-block uncached memory read bandwidth reached 433.75 GB/sec, and write bandwidth reached 188.22 GB/sec. However, single-core performance represents a relative tradeoff, with stress-ng single-core CPU performance and Passmark memory scores falling into the average middle 50% tier.

This hardware configuration is optimized for large-scale parallel processing, such as large language model inference, where it processes 5633.5 tokens per second for prompt processing on a medium 7B model. It is also highly capable in database operations, achieving 203.54 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks. Given the high density of specialized accelerators, system memory, and NVMe storage, this server represents a high-end hardware class tailored for intensive AI training, complex simulations, and massive data processing pipelines rather than general-purpose or single-threaded tasks.
